fields.name: Ember & Spice Grill
fields.tone_notes: Warm, friendly and family-run. We talk to customers like regulars, even on their first visit. Short, upbeat sentences with a little East London charm. One or two emojis at most. Never pushy or salesy. Always say thank you.
fields.halal_statement: All our meat is halal, certified by HMC.
fields.allergen_statement: Our kitchen handles nuts, sesame, gluten and dairy. Please tell our team about any allergy before you order.

recent_posts.text: Our Smash Burger is a little East London favourite 😋 Double beef patty, melted cheese, our house sauce and a soft brioche bun, £8.95. Add Masala Chips for £3.50 and you're sorted. Thank you for supporting our family kitchen. Pop in this week!

Our Seekh Kebabs are minced lamb with fresh herbs and a little green chilli, flame-grilled over charcoal, two pieces for £7.95. Simple, honest grilling, just the way we like it 🙏 Come say hello this week.

Our Mixed Grill Platter is a proper feast 🔥 Lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab and wings, all flame-grilled over charcoal and served with naan and salad, just £18.50. Perfect for sharing (or not, we won't judge). Pop in tonight and dig in!
Warm kunafa with pistachio and cream, £5.95. The perfect way to finish your grill. 😋
This weekend: a free Mango Lassi with every Mixed Grill Platter. See you Saturday!
Our lamb chops are marinated overnight and flame-grilled over real charcoal. Four pieces for £13.95. Pop in tonight! 🔥

content.text: Morning team, here are this week's 3 quick shoots. Each takes about 5 minutes on a phone during service. Please keep customers' faces and children out of shot. Thank you!

shoots.what: Peri Peri Wings (8) on the pass, ready to go out
shoots.where: The pass, just before the plate goes to the table
shoots.how: Phone held vertical, 10 seconds. Shoot from slightly above, using the kitchen light. Pan slowly across the plate. Wipe the plate rim and keep the background tidy.
shoots.caption: Peri Peri Wings, 8 to a plate, £7.50. Charcoal grill favourites from our family kitchen. Thank you for being our regulars 😋

shoots.what: Karak Chai being poured into a cup
shoots.where: The drinks station or a clean table by the window
shoots.how: Phone vertical, 8 to 10 seconds. Film the pour close up, then a short hold on the cup. Natural window light works best. Keep hands and cup in shot, no customers' faces.
shoots.caption: Karak Chai, £2.50. Pour one, stay a while. Thank you for popping in to see us.

shoots.what: Chicken Tikka plated up, with a quick close-up of the plate
shoots.where: The pass or a clean table near the window
shoots.how: Phone vertical, a photo plus a 6 second clip. Shoot at a slight angle, about 30cm away. Use window light if you can and avoid the flash. Wipe the plate rim first.
shoots.who: A server or anyone on the pass
shoots.caption: Chicken Tikka, £9.50. All our meat is halal, certified by HMC. Come and see us this weekend, we'd love to have you. Thank you!
